title: Catch A Canoe & Bicycles Too!

services.name: Rental Bikes
services.desc: Catch a Canoe (CAC) was created in 1972 and was in existence prior to the inception of The Stanford Inn. In 1981, we, known at that time as Big River Lodge - Country Inn by the Sea, began renting bikes on the other side of the road from Catch A Canoe. CAC was closed in 1981-82 due to the owner’s legal issues.
